findings.title: Redundant Array.isArray checks in diffValues
findings.why: `isPlainObject` already excludes arrays, so `&& !Array.isArray(from) && !Array.isArray(to)` can never change the result. The same helper is used without these checks at lines 260 and 264.

findings.title: Plan documents are empty scaffolds
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) contain only the template placeholder comment, with no plan body. Task files 001, 003, 004 and 005 also still carry the scaffold comment.
